articles.summary: 2nd Quarter 2026 Highlights: Net income was $97.9 million for the current quarter, an increase of $15.8 million, or 19 percent, from the prior quarter net income of $82.1 million and an increase of $45.1 million, or 85 percent, from the prior year second quarter net income of $52.8 million.
articles.title: Glacier Bancorp, Inc. Announces Results for the Quarter and Period Ended June 30, 2026
